entries.title: 切片 1（重定 · 小版）· 鬼界民居 demo
entries.outline: Small real-content slice proposal for a one-room ghost-home demo in reforge Canvas 2D: Li Xiaoyao walks/collides and talks to one or two ghosts; scope excludes editor/migration/combat/menu/save/scene switching/complex animation; reuse original tiles/sprites and hand-write scene data; minimal Scene/Map/Entity/Dialogue model; three-layer state, instantiable engine, pure movement/collision, Renderer interface, action-handler registry; build order content→renderer/input→assets→movement→dialogue; browser walk/collision/dialogue acceptance and a few focused tests.
conflicts: The document says it replaces the old WebGL/MMO/general-room spec and calls itself current, while the live registry/review classify it as historical archive-record. Its claims require current decisions/code review before citation.
Source asset/room selection is deferred to build time; the original many-room fixed image is to be cropped to one room, so exact asset identity is not fixed here.
The “browser can really play” acceptance is a proposal, not evidence from this readonly read.
entries.stopLine: Do not cite this archive as current canonical truth or runtime proof; re-enable only through a current slice spec/code review with fixed source asset and scope decisions.
entries.successor: Current phase2 decisions and any newly reviewed canonical slice-1 content/reforge spec; the old spec.md is explicitly replaced in the text but remains archive-only.

entries.title: 切片 1 补漏:静态 NPC 碰撞(static-npc-collision plan)
entries.outline: Historical static-NPC collision TDD plan: identifies collide as a dead field; constrains scope to fixed-position entities; adds pure sameTile(pixelToTile) plus an isBlocked wrapper while preserving resolveMove semantics; specifies focused collision tests, reforge check/lint, and a browser check for blocked passage plus dialogue and detour.
conflicts: The plan records implementation commands and checkboxes, but its own header says they are an old snapshot; no current implementation acceptance is granted by this review.
Dynamic NPC movement, dynamic collision, and avoidance are explicitly outside scope.
The plan’s “browser verify passed” self-review is historical prose and cannot be counted as present E2E/visual evidence.
entries.stopLine: Do not execute or cite this plan as current work; consult capability-map, task card, current collision code/tests, and a new reviewed successor.
entries.successor: Current reforge collision implementation/tests and capability-map/task-card evidence; any new dynamic-collision design must be separately scoped.

entries.title: 切片 1「室内场景跑通」实现计划（slice 1 plan）
entries.outline: Historical implementation plan for two packages and an indoor vertical slice: workspace wiring; content schema, indexed-PNG decode, scene parsing/validation, hand-written scene/assets; reforge entities/grid/collision/resolveMove/state/cutscene/interaction/input/fixed tick; then camera, WebGL2 textured-quad rendering, identity postprocess, Canvas2D text, and browser/rAF dev entry; concludes with self-review and handoff.
conflicts: The plan’s WebGL2, MMO leave, and generic-room scope is explicitly superseded by Canvas 2D first, real DLC content, and no MMO leave.
Many task checkboxes and commands are historical instructions, not evidence the full plan was implemented.
Its later README/decisions links point to the current direction; this plan must not be used as an execution checklist.
entries.stopLine: Do not execute this plan or treat its checkboxes/self-review as completion; use the current refocused slice design and decisions, and reopen only with a new plan.
entries.successor: docs/phase2/archive/slices/indoor/guijie-minju.md as the historical refocused slice proposal, current phase2 decisions, and a newly reviewed implementation plan if the slice restarts.

entries.title: P1 · 切片 1：室内场景跑通（slice 1 spec）
entries.outline: Historical P1 indoor-slice spec: goal and scope table; D1–D9 mapping; content/reforge package layout; scene/map/entity/cutscene schema; indexed-PNG assets; three-layer state and lightweight component entities; pure movement and separate world/entity collision; declarative event/dialogue; WebGL2 plus Canvas2D text; loop/input/error/module boundaries; tests, build order, and future items.
conflicts: The spec is explicitly pre-refocus WebGL2/MMO/general-room and says “do not execute”; current direction is Canvas 2D first, real DLC slice, and no MMO leave.
It contains an unresolved assumption about 32×16 offset tiling versus square tiles for original visual fidelity; it is not a settled current decision.
The document points to guijie-minju.md as the rewritten current slice-1 spec, but the live registry keeps both as historical archive; neither is runtime proof here.
entries.stopLine: Do not execute or cite this draft as current canonical spec; rewrite/review from current decisions and the successor slice before any implementation.
entries.successor: docs/phase2/archive/slices/indoor/guijie-minju.md is the named textual successor; current phase2 decisions and reforge/content implementation must be revalidated before use.
